title.narrative: Lifesaving response to the populations affected by the fighting in Laas Caanood through emergency Shelter/NFI interventions in Xudun district of Sool

description.narrative:
ltpgtThe fighting in Laas Caanood has resulted in displacement of about 154,000 to 203,000 people. The fighting, which has sporadically continued since then, has led to displacement of an estimated 154,000-203,000 people to neighboring districts.lt/pgtltpgtIn this reserve allocation JF will work with the conflict affected beneficiaries to ensure that they are provided with both the NFIs Kits and 2 plastic sheets.lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtThe project will consider the protection mainstreaming of gender and people living with disabilities with related issues, as well as inclusion of people with disability matter in both the response and it’s monitoring to ensure safety and dignity of target beneficiarieslt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtJF will therefore through the intervention:ltbrgt 1. Procured NFIs will be distributed to the registered beneficiaries of 3000 HH, (18000 beneficiaries comprising of 5900 women,3830 men 4,230girls and 4,040 boys in Hudun town and Lafweyn, Higlo fulan, Awrbogeys, Lascurdin and Gorofley villagesltbrgt 2. plastic sheets will be distributed among the same targeted beneficiaries in lt/spangtHudun, Lafweyn, Higlo fulan, Awrbogeys, Lascurdin and Gorofley 3. Carry out a post distribution monitoring to evaluate the impact of the distribution to the targeted beneficiaries and also to ensure that every registered HH got the entitlement.lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gt3. Carry out a post distribution monitoring to evaluate the impact of the distribution to the targeted beneficiaries and also to ensure that every registered HH got the entitlement.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gt4. JF will also distribute the 2-plastic sheet which will target the same 3000HHs that benefit from NFIs.ltbrgtJF will ensure inclusivity and transparency in targeting will employ a participatory approach when identifying and selecting beneficiaries. The key focus will be on HHs with the most vulnerable and marginalized groups of people including those with disabilities, children headed HHs, HHs with orphans, and HHs with elderly people and young children under the age of 5 years. This approach will ensure that the interests of those people are captured and to be tailored for. With the aim of promoting ownership of the project and adherence to commitment number 3 of the Core Humanitarian Standards, the project will employ an owner-driven approach where the response will strengthen local capacities on putting up the shelter structures ltbrgt JF will work closely with partners operating in the region such Alight NGO, NODO, among other NGOS to ensure that there is a well coordinated service delivery to the beneficiaries. lt/spangtWe will participate in all the coordination meetings both with the local administration or the humanitarian actors as well as the shelter cluster.lt/pgtltpgt
